entry.name: jit.geom.tomesh
entry.description: Use jit.geom.tomesh to convert geometry to a jit.gl.mesh. Typically, you want to use jit.geom.tomesh over jit.geom.tomatrix if you want to directly render it as it is more performant for that use case.
